card.name: Hedging verbs in warning statements
card.fires_on: Small verbs or modifiers such as "may", "more" (in "may be more reactive") and "have" in warning sentences. They come right before the effect or consequence is stated.

modes.label: May / more before an effect
modes.description: The word "may" or "more" sits in a hedged warning about increased reactivity or risk.

modes.label: Verb before a role or outcome
modes.description: A verb such as "may" or "have" comes just before a described role or worsening of a condition.
